# Doomkey

Doomkey is an apps and services studio based in Bangladesh. We set up business
email, simple websites, and search presence for small businesses. Live within
days. Nothing technical on your end.

## Services

- **Business email** — Professional addresses on your own domain, set up and
  sending within a day: https://doomkeybd.com/email-service
- **Websites** — One clear page buyers and Google can trust:
  https://doomkeybd.com/website-service
- **SEO + AEO** — Business profile, consistent listings, and a site Google and
  AI assistants can read: https://doomkeybd.com/seo-service
